purpose: Measure whether performance add-ons or new nodes are justified for the Emilia workflow

environment.gpu_reported: NVIDIA CMP 40HX (Windows D3D adapter alias: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070)
environment.attention_backend: PyTorch attention / SDPA; memory-efficient backend usable, flash backend unavailable

method: Submit the same safe workflow, 832x1216, seed 20261201, 12 KSampler steps, batch 1, with upscale nodes removed to isolate native generation. One run per profile; compare sampler step timing separately from cold-start and full prompt timing. GPU was monitored with nvidia-smi at 1-second intervals.

comparison.assessment: visually close, but this profile is not faster end-to-end; --fast autotune and reduced precision do not justify the image and memory tradeoffs
visually close; steady sampler speed is effectively unchanged. Lower wall time is confounded by much shorter model initialization/cache conditions, so do not attribute it to this flag.
exactly pixel-identical; steady sampler speed matches PyTorch SDPA within measurement noise, so the package was removed

gpu_observations.during_sampler: GPU utilization repeatedly reached 97-100%, with P0 clocks around 1.7-1.95 GHz.
gpu_observations.power_observation: Monitoring reported approximately 180 W during full-load intervals; board power limit reports 184 W.
gpu_observations.interpretation: The existing sampler is already compute-saturated and uses nearly all VRAM headroom. Idle 0% utilization outside inference is expected; no evidence that missing custom nodes are leaving the GPU underused.

backend_compatibility.decision: xFormers 0.0.35 installed and exercised successfully, but produced no measurable step-time improvement and an identical image; it was uninstalled. SageAttention kernels target Ampere/Ada/Hopper, not this Turing 7.5 GPU. PyTorch SDPA memory-efficient attention is available, flash attention is not. Triton is absent and nvcc is unavailable. No attention package or custom node is justified by these results.

decision.recommended_profile: Existing production workflow and default runtime flags; no new nodes or attention packages.
decision.reason: No tested setting materially improved steady KSampler throughput; the GPU already reaches full utilization and the 8 GiB card peaks near 7.1 GiB. New detailer nodes add inference passes rather than increase sampler throughput.
